visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white off-the-shoulder top and dark blue jeans, sits in a classroom setting holding a silver transverse flute. Behind her, six children in school attire or casual hoodies stand and observe. The background features classroom posters and a large window. (2) The woman plays a short melody on the flute, looking towards the children. A young boy in a blue hoodie raises his hand in response. Text captions appear on the top of the screen. (3) She plays another short musical phrase. The children behind her react with excitement; one girl in a white shirt raises her hand enthusiastically. The woman smiles and nods. (4) The woman plays a third tune, looking intently at the students. Multiple children raise their hands and jump slightly. A white caption bubble appears at the top. (5) She plays a final tune while the children watch closely. A young girl in a green school uniform raises her hand. The woman turns her head to look at them while continuing to play. (6) The woman lowers the flute and engages in conversation with the children and the camera, posing with the instrument across her lap as the children smile and gesture in the background.
